title: Unified add-to-cart button
summary: Normal and KitBundle products share one add-to-cart button: Geist 12px caps with 0.12em spacing (after Moment), no icon, black sweep on hover, quantity left, live total in the label (ADD N ITEMS TO CART when bundle parts, add-ons or gifts are included). Live.
summary_zh: 普通产品和 KitBundle 产品用同一个加购按钮：Geist 12px 全大写、字距 0.12em（参考 Moment），无图标、hover 划黑，左数量右按钮，按钮里带实时总额（有配件 / 赠品时 ADD N ITEMS TO CART）。已上线。

rounds.notes: Button text now follows Moment's add-to-cart: Geist 12px, regular, all caps, 0.12em letter spacing (live 17 Nov, KitBundle kitbundle-130 + theme). All 'after' screenshots are the final live version; the overview has a new 'Label font after Moment' section.
rounds.notes_zh: 按钮文字改成参考 Moment：Geist 12px 常规、全大写、字距 0.12em（11/17 已上线，KitBundle kitbundle-130 + 主题）。所有「改后」截图换成最终上线版；总览新增「字体参考 Moment」一节。
